# terrakube_collection (Data Source)

Looks up a variable collection by name within a Terrakube organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "terrakube_organization" "org" {
  name = "my-organization"
}

data "terrakube_collection" "shared" {
  organization_id = data.terrakube_organization.org.id
  name            = "shared-settings"
}

output "collection_priority" {
  value = data.terrakube_collection.shared.priority
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Collection name
- `organization_id` (String) Terrakube organization ID

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Collection description, null when it has none
- `id` (String) Collection ID
- `priority` (Number) Collection priority
